title: ADR-0048 Addendum A still reads Proposed; it was accepted on 2026-08-08 (#1825); record that its exclusivity gate stays bound to A.5
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ③ stale documentation with a named location. Maintainer, verbatim (Claude Code session, 2026-11-06): 「同意」, accepting the seat's revised recommendation, after an isolated contract-review-tier re-read, **not** to build the marketplace namespace-exclusivity gate now and only to correct the record. Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」.

## Problem

`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` lines 8 and 370 say the 2026-08-08 Addendum A (publish-time / marketplace namespace exclusivity) is "Proposed". The maintainer accepted it the same day: #1825, comment at 13:55Z, "ADR-0048 addendum ACCEPTED as drafted"; PR #6671 merged. Agents and people reading the ADR conclude the contract is undecided.

## Ask

1. Change the addendum's status to Accepted (2026-08-08), citing #1825's acceptance comment, in both places.
2. Add one dated note under §A.5: as of 2026-11-06 the exclusivity gate (phase A2) stays bound to A.5's precondition, landing before third-party publishing opens. While publishing is first-party only, first-party namespaces are reserved at switch-on by D2 + D4, so no separate official reserved list is needed. Phase A1 is landed (#6864, objectstack-ai/cloud#1927).
3. No code change.

Reader: the `domain:engine` lane seat, from `pm:queue`.
